content: {"rule": "K-S2", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text uses a single verse's admitted two readings as the reason for UNDERDETERMINED, which is the situation the rule governs.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "UNDERDETERMINED -- the passive egennēthē (was born) with feminine hēs (of whom) admits both the withheld-father and the birth-narration readings", "rule_words": "That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.
